candidates.title: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon broadly available
candidates.summary: Google moved Gemini 4 Carbon from a limited cyber-defender rollout into paid API, enterprise and consumer availability, kept introductory pricing at $2 per million input and $10 per million output tokens through November 30, and previewed a multi-agent /swarm workflow.
candidates.what_changed: The watchlisted limited rollout now has developer documentation and paid API access in AI Studio, enterprise access in Gemini for business, and product access for Google AI Ultra subscribers.
candidates.why_it_matters: Engineers can now evaluate the model in production-facing workflows and compare its higher-cost long-horizon profile against Gemini 4 Argon, while treating vendor safety and benchmark claims as scoped evidence.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Benchmark Carbon on representative long-running tasks at full task cost, and validate safeguard, scope and review behavior independently before assigning broad permissions.

evidence.rationale: Google documents the product surfaces, API access, introductory and future prices, model role and safeguard evaluations.
evidence.independent_validation: The availability and prices are directly verifiable; performance and safety results remain a mix of vendor and named external evaluations not reproduced in this pass.
evidence.claim_scope: Availability, pricing and product surfaces are established; capability and safeguard claims remain evaluation-scoped.

signal.rationale: A previously limited frontier model now has a concrete developer and enterprise access contract.

deduplication.canonical_event: Google makes Gemini 4 Carbon available through paid developer, enterprise and consumer surfaces.
deduplication.previous_coverage: The 2026-10-29 ledger watchlisted the limited Fairwind cyber-defender rollout and named broader developer access as the promotion condition.
deduplication.material_delta: Paid API and enterprise access, documentation, explicit pricing and a preview /swarm workflow are now available.

candidates.title: Microsoft shows ten dormant neurons can backdoor an AI agent
candidates.summary: Microsoft researchers report that fewer than ten dormant neurons can be reprogrammed without retraining to trigger arbitrary token payloads in an agent while ordinary evaluations remain clean.
candidates.what_changed: The work demonstrates an inference-compute weight-editing attack, shows example terminal payloads, and argues for model-weight provenance, differential inspection and defense-in-depth permission controls.
candidates.why_it_matters: Agent teams cannot treat clean behavioral evaluations as proof that a checkpoint has intact weights, especially when the model can invoke tools or a terminal.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Pin and verify model artifacts, compare weights against declared bases, restrict agent permissions and monitor consequential actions; treat scanning as one imperfect layer.

evidence.rationale: The researcher describes the attack, threat model, examples, mitigations and product-response context.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent reproduction was identified in the bounded pass.
evidence.claim_scope: The demonstrated weight-editing attack requires write access to model weights; the post does not establish prevalence in deployed systems.

signal.rationale: The result exposes a concrete supply-chain and runtime threat for tool-using agents.

deduplication.canonical_event: Microsoft Research discloses the Lazarus weight-space agent backdoor technique.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL, Lazarus event or dormant-neuron backdoor coverage was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A new attack and mitigation study was published.

candidates.title: DeepMind uses AI agents to formally verify Signal's protocol code
candidates.summary: Google DeepMind says AlphaProof Code, guided by human experts, produced mathematical proofs for key security properties of the implementation underlying Signal's cryptographic protocol and released verification artifacts.
candidates.what_changed: The project applied an agentic formal-verification framework to widely deployed cryptographic code at a depth Google describes as unprecedented.
candidates.why_it_matters: This is a stronger engineering claim than code review or test generation: it targets machine-checked proof obligations for production cryptographic implementation.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Inspect the released artifacts, assumptions and trusted proof stack before generalizing the result; formal proof covers stated properties, not every implementation or operational risk.

evidence.rationale: DeepMind describes the system, target, claimed firsts and open verification artifacts.
evidence.independent_validation: The bounded pass did not locate an independent audit of the complete proof effort.
evidence.claim_scope: The result applies to stated properties and proof assumptions; it is not a blanket guarantee for Signal or all cryptographic software.

signal.rationale: Formal verification of widely deployed cryptographic implementation is a durable engineering event.

deduplication.canonical_event: DeepMind publishes AlphaProof Code verification work on Signal protocol implementation.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL or matching AlphaProof Code/Signal verification event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A new formal-verification result and artifact release was published.

candidates.title: AWS gives coding agents a local cloud API target
candidates.summary: AWS released a free open-source local emulator in Rust that exposes AWS-shaped HTTPS APIs to existing CLI, SDK, test and coding-agent workflows without deploying resources to a Region.
candidates.what_changed: Developers can redirect unchanged AWS SDK calls to a local endpoint; AWS says the emulator supports services represented in its API-model repository and preserves request and error shapes.
candidates.why_it_matters: Coding agents can create and inspect cloud-shaped resources in a bounded local loop, reducing deployment latency and accidental cloud changes during iteration.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Test service fidelity and unsupported behavior before relying on it for integration coverage, and keep emulator credentials and certificates isolated from real AWS profiles.

evidence.rationale: AWS documents installation, local endpoint behavior, API-model coverage and coding-agent use.
evidence.independent_validation: The emulator was not independently exercised in this run.
evidence.claim_scope: Launch and interface are established; behavioral fidelity across services remains first-party.

signal.rationale: The tool changes the safe iteration loop for cloud-integrated coding agents.

deduplication.canonical_event: AWS releases its local API emulator with explicit coding-agent support.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL or matching AWS Emulator launch event was found; an October ledger mention of Android emulators is unrelated.
deduplication.material_delta: A new open-source AWS-compatible local execution target became available.

candidates.title: Agent Skills joins MCP under Linux Foundation governance
candidates.summary: Google says Anthropic donated the Agent Skills specification to the Linux Foundation's Agentic AI Foundation alongside MCP, with Google, Anthropic, OpenAI and the wider ecosystem co-maintaining the standards.
candidates.what_changed: A reusable agent-instruction format moved from vendor stewardship into the same vendor-neutral governance venue as MCP.
candidates.why_it_matters: Teams adopting skills and MCP gain a clearer interoperability and governance path, though conformance, security and implementation compatibility still need evidence.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Keep skills portable and auditable, separate procedural packages from credentials, and verify implementation compatibility rather than assuming a shared foundation guarantees it.

evidence.rationale: Google identifies the donation, governance home and participating maintainers.
evidence.independent_validation: No conformance or cross-implementation study was found in the bounded pass.
evidence.claim_scope: The governance change is established; interoperability and security benefits remain prospective.

signal.rationale: Standards ownership can durably shape agent tooling and portability.

deduplication.canonical_event: Agent Skills moves into AAIF governance alongside MCP.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL, Agent Skills donation or matching AAIF governance event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: Specification ownership and co-maintenance moved to a vendor-neutral foundation.

candidates.title: ElevenLabs and NVIDIA put a sovereign voice agent into Poland's e-health platform
candidates.summary: ElevenLabs and NVIDIA expanded their partnership across models and infrastructure, added Nemotron 3.5 Super VL to ElevenAgents, announced 15MW of NVIDIA compute expansion, and named a sovereign voice-agent deployment for Poland's national e-health platform.
candidates.what_changed: The partnership now combines model availability, a large infrastructure commitment and a named government-health deployment rather than a generic collaboration promise.
candidates.why_it_matters: The deployment makes data location, model hosting, accessibility and human escalation concrete architecture questions for a public-service voice agent.
candidates.engineer_takeaway: Separate confirmed platform availability from deployment outcomes, and demand details on data boundaries, evaluation, fallback and accessibility before inferring public-service effectiveness.

evidence.rationale: ElevenLabs documents the expanded partnership, model integration, compute commitment and named deployment.
evidence.independent_validation: No independent deployment result or user-outcome evidence was identified.
evidence.claim_scope: The partnership and stated deployment are first-party facts; performance, adoption and public-service outcomes are unmeasured.

signal.rationale: A named sovereign public-sector deployment plus concrete infrastructure and model changes clears generic partnership coverage.

deduplication.canonical_event: ElevenLabs and NVIDIA expand their partnership with a named Poland e-health voice-agent deployment.
deduplication.previous_coverage: No exact URL, named Poland e-health deployment or matching partnership event was found on pinned main.
deduplication.material_delta: A concrete model, infrastructure and sovereign deployment package was announced.

watchlist.title: Google launches a benchmark for visually complex knowledge work
watchlist.summary: Google and Artificial Analysis introduced a 200-task multimodal knowledge-agent benchmark across ten verticals and released ten public examples plus an open-source harness.
watchlist.what_changed: A new evaluation targets visually structured professional files and reports 96% agreement between its autorater and domain experts.
watchlist.reason: The full 200-task set is private and the launch is tied to Gemini 4 Carbon performance; retain until broader model coverage or independent methodological review clarifies its value beyond the model launch.
promote_when: Independent replication, expanded public tasks, or a material cross-model methodological result appears.

watchlist.title: WorkflowArena measures how agents design their own delegations
watchlist.summary: A preprint introduces 145 long-horizon tasks across eight domains to evaluate both final deliverables and the workflows agents author.
watchlist.what_changed: The work treats orchestration structure as a capability and reports that no single model configuration leads every domain.
watchlist.reason: The benchmark is a fresh preprint with hidden verification and no independent reproduction identified in the bounded pass.
promote_when: Code, tasks or independent replications establish the benchmark's robustness.

exclusions.summary: OpenAI announced an access program for U.S. veterans and servicemembers.

exclusions.reason: The announcement does not clear the Daily News relevance and evidence threshold; retain existing pilot Curious responsibility without manufacturing a culture story.
